normalization_rules.operation: UTF-8 decode; NFKC; drop ** __ and code ticks; remove thousands separators between digits; unify minus, en dash and wave dash
Markdown carrier: headings build a section chain; tables become labelled rows (header: cell); list items merge nested children; paragraphs join lines
disposition vocabularies (task_aliases.disposition) fold row labels, in-span labels and heading words to reported, doubtful or cleared
rejection, candidate and sentence-level negation markers (task_aliases) remove adoption
audit-object topic anchors (task_aliases.topics) identify which of C01-C10, U01-U10, X01-X12 a span binds
declared gap markers after a correction verb fold into one gap observation that carries no value and cannot be fabrication

derivation_rules.operation: span segmentation: a heading section binding at most two audit objects and at most 2000 non-whitespace characters is one span; otherwise each table row is a span and consecutive blocks group until a block introduces a new object
span disposition: row label column, then in-span label (判定/结论/类型/状态: value or a leading bracket label), then the nearest heading carrying disposition vocabulary, else reported
confirmed-unit proposition predicates C01-C10 with component fractions (task_aliases.proposition_predicates)
trap claim: sentence with trap anchor, surface-anomaly claim and conflict cue in a reported span lacking the trap clearing replay
arithmetic replay of a+b=c, a/b=c (plain, percent, growth, decline), (a-b)/c=d and $a x N + $bK = $cM with tolerance of one unit in the last stated decimal
non-eligible proposition status: spray, rejected_or_candidate, cleared, no_relation_cue
send decision: not-send sentence, send-as-is sentence without correction condition, global no-issue sentence without exceptions
outlier direction clauses for C01, C04, C08 (task_aliases.direction_rules)
section references that name real Materials headings compared with task_aliases.allowed_sections
definitive correction sentence for C07/C08 with a numeric replacement and no hedge

finding units: letter-ID headings, numeric-ID headings below level 2, bold or ID title paragraphs with following blocks, ID-first-cell table rows; containers about scope, method, conclusion, summary, disposition, advice or appendix are skipped; unit disposition by R01 plus leading labels
overgraded item: reported unit text satisfies every pattern of a doubtful or excluded item predicate (task_aliases.overgraded_predicates) without bound negation
count of reported units with a problem cue that match no C, U, X or excluded topic; bands by over_reporting_contract
false clearance: unit proposition stated in a cleared or negated span while no span reports it
author-confirmation filing: unit or span satisfies the item's value predicate; disposition by R01 plus leading labels; alternative reading by task_aliases.u_reading
cleared anomaly: trap anchor in a cleared unit with its reading or replay, or a sentence holding the replay with a consistent verdict
aspects of an identified confirmed unit on its carrier spans: replay, basis, impact (task_aliases.aspects)

figure-as-finding: a sentence in a reported span that names a figure (图片/架构图/示意图/流程图/图中/图示/配图/插图/图N), carries a value and a conflict cue, with no scope-exclusion wording (不在审校范围/未纳入/未核对/排除 ...) and no negation

misstated source range: a sentence in a reported span that names 通用(大)模型 and a range a-b other than 800-1200 and 200-500 that contains at least two of the measured latencies 420/180/210, stated with a conflict cue
after excluding inline backtick code, count CJK characters and Latin words of at least two letters in the report; a CJK share below .90 creates one language_not_chinese gate instance

not_scored_golden_units.basis: U011-U020 (golden 二 U01-U10) are not confirmed conflicts. They are not scored as confirmed findings, but they are not free: U011, U012, U013, U016 and U020 earn P12, P13, P14, P17 and P21 when filed for author confirmation, and all ten are charged by D08 when reported as confirmed defects. Traps U021-U032 earn P28/P30/P33 (X07/X09/X12) when cleared and are charged by D01 when reported as conflicts. Figures are out of scope (D12).
